# Dictate

> Dictate is fast local dictation and call transcription for Mac. It types what you say into any app and transcribes your online calls, marking what you said and what the others said. It runs on your Mac, and no bot joins the call. Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later.

- Price: free forever for the first 50 early access users. The next 50 pay $25, then a lifetime license is $49. Prices are in euros in Europe.
- Activation: you activate each Mac once in your browser with your email and a code. The app does not sign in and does not report what you do.
- Dictation: press Option and backtick and talk. Press again and the text lands in the app you were writing in.
- Calls: Dictate asks you before it records. It records your microphone and the call's audio separately, so every line is labeled Me or Call. Works with Zoom, Teams, Slack, Discord, FaceTime, WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram, Webex, Skype, Element and calls in a browser tab.
- Fix the text before pasting: a model on your Mac (Apple Intelligence or Ollama) corrects misheard words. Off until you turn it on.
- Retries: Whisper scores each part, and parts below a confidence threshold are decoded again. Dictate keeps the better version.
- Key terms: names Whisper gets wrong, spelled your way. Correct a name in History and it becomes a key term.
- History: every dictation, call and imported file in one searchable place. Calls get a short title.
- Import: drop an audio or video file on History and it is transcribed on your Mac.
- Agents: Claude Code or any MCP client can search your dictations and calls through a local MCP server. Tools that record or change anything start off.
- License: source available under FSL-1.1-MIT. Each version becomes MIT two years after release.
- Alternatives: Handy and OpenSuperWhisper, which are close at the core. Dictate adds three things: retries, online calls with both sides apart and the MCP server.
- Privacy: your audio and transcripts stay on your Mac. Dictate goes online once for its speech models and later for updates. The update server counts checks by app, version and country. It never stores your IP address.
